configuracoes.erro.destaques_n: The number of highlights must be a whole number from 1 to 100. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.fontes.explicacao: One switch per source. A source that is off does not run and shows as off in source health.
configuracoes.funcoes.explicacao: Each feature has its own switch. When off, it stops acting; whatever was already saved stays.
configuracoes.funcao.descoberta_cc_ligad: When off, discovery does not run. Suggestions already made stay on screen.
configuracoes.funcao.paginas_ligadas.aju: When off, no page is checked.
configuracoes.funcao.enriquecimento_liga: When off, job detail pages are not fetched, and the sitemap sources bring no new jobs.
configuracoes.funcao.destaques_ligados.a: When off, the tab goes away and the panel opens on All.
configuracoes.funcao.conversao_moeda_lig: When off, no exchange rate is requested; a job in another currency keeps only its original amount and the salary rule does not hide it. Jobs in reais stay as they are.
configuracoes.funcao.regras_ocultar_liga: When off, nothing is hidden by rule. Hiding by hand still works.
configuracoes.funcoes.destaques_n.ajuda: How many jobs the Highlights tab shows, from 1 to 100.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.explicacao: With background on, joBot starts by itself with your user session and looks for jobs while you do something else.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.nao_linux: Background only works on Linux. On this machine it stays off.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.ligar.ajuda: Creates the systemd user service. Turning it off removes the service.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.recusa: Could not change the background setting.
configuracoes.aparencia.explicacao: Theme and language apply to the whole panel and are kept on this computer.
configuracoes.privacidade.onde: Everything stays on this computer, in the folder:
configuracoes.privacidade.telemetria: joBot has no account and no ads: no telemetry and none of your data is sent. It only makes network requests in these cases: to the public job sources you leave on (they all come on), including each job's page; to the Central Bank of Brazil, to get the dollar rate, with currency conversion on (it comes on); to Common Crawl, once a week, to discover new companies, and then to those companies' job boards, to check them (it comes on); to the pages you ask it to follow (it comes on, but with no pages on the list there is no request); to a company's website, only when you paste an address, test it or accept a suggestion; to the internet through git and uv, to download the new joBot version, only when you ask to update (the jobot atualizar command). If you turn on the version notice below, it also asks GitHub (it comes off). Whoever receives a request sees your computer's IP address, as with any internet request.
configuracoes.privacidade.disco: Your data sits in ordinary files. We recommend turning on disk encryption on your computer, so nobody can read the folder above if the device is lost.
configuracoes.privacidade.aviso_versao: Tell me when a new version is out
configuracoes.privacidade.aviso_versao.a: When on, once a day joBot asks GitHub for the latest version. The request carries no search or personal data, only your IP, like any request on the internet. When off, this notice makes no request.
